newsitem.title: UK: Euro oil swaps firm as screen crude consolidates.
newsitem.headline: Euro oil swaps firm as screen crude consolidates.

text.p: European oil swaps were broadly firmer on Tuesday as screen crude consolidated yesterday's gains prompted by expected delays of Iraqi exports.
Brent CFDs were up to 15 cents stronger on the close-in contracts and 10 cents or so further out. Heavy fuel swaps gained by 75 cents or so and gasoline ticked up $1.

Brent CFDs were bolstered by screen crude and tight wet barrels and CFDs for the balance of this week jumped to -11/12 cents against August Brent from -22 cents. July 7-11 was hovering around -14 cents from -27 cents while July 14-18 was pegged at -21 cents from -30 cents. July 21-25 was assessed at -21 cents from -31 cents.
Gas oil spreads were narrowly easier with 4Q at $4.40, 1Q98 at $4.55 and steady at $4.10.
Heavy fuel swaps levels were about 75 cents higher with July valued between $83.75/$84 with a 75 cent or so contango remaining into August and a further 50 cents into September.
July gasoline swaps were about $1 firmer with $186.25 trading. The backwardation into August continued with August talked either side of $185 and September nearer $183.
